motivation: Independent common-random-number omitted-state stress assays found that police professionalism, government formation veterancy, and insurgent formation veterancy are causally active at the mechanism level but produced zero preregistered practically-large macro-outcome states over the 30-day closure horizon. The prior candidate-specific matching comparison nevertheless improved from competitive11v2 to competitive14v2 on one synthetic support. This contract determines on untouched support whether the three tactical/micro-memory variables are actually required in the reduced macrostate or whether that apparent closure gain was matching/support variation.

evidence_available_before_registration.reaction_transport_screening_baseline_se: competitive14v2 happened to produce 0/12 multiplicity-significant failures on the smaller 2026103000 screening support; no competitive11v2 outcome on that support was examined before this contract.

theory_principle: A variable can be causally real inside the micro-mechanism while still being screened off by a lower-dimensional macrostate at a specified horizon. Reduced theory should retain only variables whose omission measurably breaks distributional closure.

candidate_models.competitive11v2: M, logF, E, C, logKo, neighbor-member pressure, L, Kintel, X, S, U
candidate_models.competitive14v2: competitive11v2 + police professionalism + government veterancy + insurgent veterancy
candidate_models.transport12v2: competitive11v2 + inbound insurgent transport pressure T
candidate_models.reaction_transport14v2: competitive11v2 + local renewal potential R + organization persistence P + inbound transport pressure T

selection_rule: Among candidates that pass the same preregistered closure threshold, prefer the lowest-dimensional candidate. If dimensions tie, prefer lower multiplicity-significant failure rate, then lower raw practically-large rate, then lower median normalized match distance.

interpretation.competitive11_passes: TACTICAL_MICROSTATES_SCREENED_OFF_AT_30D; professionalism/veterancy remain mechanistic ABM state but are removed from the reduced macrostate.
interpretation.competitive11_fails_competitive14_passes: TACTICAL_MICROSTATES_REQUIRED_OR_PROXYING_MISSING_STATE; retain provisionally and investigate which omitted-state intervention lacks support.
interpretation.reaction_transport14_needed: Local renewal-memory and transport both survive the dimensional reduction gate.
interpretation.none_pass: CURRENT_REDUCED_ARCHITECTURE_NOT_CLOSED; diagnose omitted state rather than adding variables by intuition.

guard: No historical data may be consulted to choose among these candidates. Police professionalism and veterancy are not deleted from the production ABM regardless of macrostate compression outcome.
